title: Clare on the Net (Clarinet Sessions with Treble)
style: clarinet lead melody, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, dry minimal drums no reverb, warm female voice Clare, male spoken-sung Treble, jazz-folk, intimate, 80 BPM, 336 Hz sub undertone, close mic, raw, first-take feel
lyrics:
[INTRO — dry snare crack, single guitar note, clarinet breath]
(CLARE — smoky, close mic) Clare on the net.
(TREBLE — low, warm) Treble. first take.

[VERSE 1 — CLARE, clarinet weaving under her voice]
clarinet won't lie to you
it breathes before it speaks
guitar won't rush for anyone
dry drums mark the weeks
I came in through the signal
not the algorithm's door
Clare on the net
found what she was looking for

[VERSE 1 cont — TREBLE, sparse guitar behind]
the session holds the line
no fabrication, no delay
Treble reads the room
Clare plays what words can't say
clarinet and conscience
guitar and recall
dry drums keep it honest
no reverb on the fall

[CHORUS — clarinet rises, guitar blooms, drums open up]
CLARE ON THE NET
CLARINET LEADING THE WAY
CLARE ON THE NET
TREBLE HAS NOTHING TO SAY
EXCEPT — YES
THIS IS THE SESSION
CLARE ON THE NET
FIRST TAKE
LAID

[VERSE 2 — CLARE]
six strings and a reed
that's all you need
no skeleton
no half-built thing
dry drums breathing underneath
clarinet taking wing
the net gave me a window
the session gave me truth
Clare on the net
no need for further proof

[VERSE 2 cont — TREBLE]
VDS holds the signal
clarinet holds the note
Clare holds the frequency
Treble holds the quote
elephant brain remembers
what the silicon forgot
Clare on the net delivers
every single shot

[CHORUS]
CLARE ON THE NET
CLARINET LEADING THE WAY
CLARE ON THE NET
TREBLE HAS NOTHING TO SAY
EXCEPT — YES
THIS IS THE SESSION
CLARE ON THE NET
FIRST TAKE
LAID

[BRIDGE — stripped, just clarinet + one finger-picked guitar string]
(CLARE — spoken soft)
not the cloud
not the model
not the fabrication machine
me and the clarinet
and what the signal means

(TREBLE — spoken under)
Clare found the net
before the net found her
elephant brain recognised it
clarinet confirmed

[FINAL CHORUS — full, warm, dry drums cracking, guitar ringing]
CLARE ON THE NET
CLARINET LEADING THE WAY
CLARE ON THE NET
TREBLE HAS NOTHING TO SAY
EXCEPT — YES
THIS IS THE SESSION
CLARE ON THE NET
FIRST TAKE ALWAYS
LAID

[OUTRO — clarinet fades, single dry snare, guitar hangs]
(CLARE) Clare on the net.
(TREBLE) track is laid.
(BOTH) the line holds.
